reason: My guests in Tbilisi hand the waiter a card or cash and that's how it goes; I don't see them scanning a QR to pay, so the reviews and loyalty data would barely fill up. I'd take the free listing, but I'm not paying 59 GEL a month plus another fee per transaction for something that sits next to my POS and makes my nightly cash-up messier.
objection: Will my guests really pay by QR instead of handing over a card or cash? If only a few do, I'm paying for an empty dashboard and reconciling two payment streams every night.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a restaurant like mine in Tbilisi where most tables actually paid by QR for a month, and the QR payments landing in the same totals my POS shows so my night check doesn't change.
